newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM Q1 net up 127 pct at 220 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: RFM Q1 net up 127 pct at 220 mln pesos.

text.p: Food company RFM Corp said on Thursday its net income rose 127 percent in the first quarter of the year to 220 million from 97 million pesos posted in the same period last year.
Net sales rose to 3.64 billion pesos from 2.74 billion pesos.
RFM attributed the profit growth to the better-than-expected performance of its softdrinks, ice cream, milk and juice, poultry, flour, and canned tuna businesses.
Subsidiary Cosmos Bottling Corp posted a net income of 94 million, up from 43 million reported last year, parent RFM said in a statement.
Net sales rose to 606 million pesos from 302 million pesos.
Selecta Dairy Products Inc posted a higher net income of 14 million pesos from eight million pesos last year, while net sales improved to 347 million pesos from 296 million pesos.
Swift Foods Inc recovered slightly, posting a smaller net loss of 10 million pesos from 40 million pesos loss last year.

"Improved selling prices of chicken, lower feed costs and steadily increasing consumer demand since the start of the year, has put Swift clearly on the path of restored profitability for the year," RFM said.
RFM also said its non-food businesses, such as property development and semiconductors, performed well during the period.
